text:
Ivy (CS): Heads-up 1: CelerisHealth asks for a 2h "Migration Playday" next Tue. Wants hands-on migration + checklist walkthrough. Can we lock time and facilitators? :spiral_calendar:
Ravi (Enablement): I can lead the workshop content but need a co-facilitator for breakouts. Prefer morning slot due to EMEA folks.
Priya_CSM: They said 6 engineers across 2 projects, some will bring staging + prod-ish sandboxes. We should scope which accounts they'll connect.
Tom_Support: I'll handle infra access and sandbox provisioning. Need a list of required IAM roles and whether they want persistent service accounts or short-lived tokens.
Ivy (CS): Proposed slots: Wed 09:0011:00 PT (17:009:00 UTC) or Thu 08:000:00 PT. Which works for enablement team?
Ravi (Enablement): Wed is better for docs handoff. Thu conflicts with another training.
Priya_CSM: Wed works for Celeris too. Confirmed with account rep.
Tom_Support: Ok Wed. I'll prep a disposable org + sandbox by Monday EOD. Will run a smoke test and post results here.
Ivy (CS): Draft agenda: 1) 10m intro + success criteria, 2) 30m architecture & migration plan, 3) 60m guided migration lab (breakouts), 4) 20m troubleshooting + next steps. Need pre-read + access checklist.
Ravi (Enablement): Recommend we add two 20min checkpoints during the lab to avoid free-for-all. Also add a short demo of rollback.
Priya_CSM: Also want a 5min renewal signal capture at the end 1: flag any timeline slippage or procurement blockers so I can escalate.
Tom_Support: Will create a quick runbook and a temp key script. Example below (internal):
```
# create short-lived key for migration
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/v1/keys"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
  -d '{"purpose":"migration_playday","ttl":"6h"}'
```
Tom_Support: I'll also provision a support channel and paste the secure notes link.
Ravi (Enablement): Who's the third facilitator? I can take the main room, Ivy can do the walkthrough. Need one more to handle breakout tickets.
Ivy (CS): @Maya (CS) usually helps but she's OOO. Any volunteers?
Priya_CSM: I can jump in for the first breakout and handle account scoping.
Ivy (CS): Great. Action items: Ravi - slides + pre-read (1p); Tom - sandbox + tokens; Priya - confirm attendees & procurement status; Ivy - final agenda + calendar invite.
OpsBot: Event queued: CelerisHealth Migration Playday 1: Wed 09:00 PT. Calendar invites will be sent once final attendees added.
Priya_CSM: Quick note 1: Celeris mentioned a potential procurement hold in Q4. I'll flag in renewal tracker and sync with Sales. If that goes dark, consider a smaller follow-up enablement focused on proof-of-value.
Ravi (Enablement): I'll timebox the lab and add acceptance checks to the pre-read (two checkpoints). That should help keep to 2h.
Tom_Support: Smoke test plan: provision sandbox, run upload + inference test, and verify KV cache warms. Will post pass/fail by Mon 17:00 PT.
Ivy (CS): Thanks all 1: if anything changes, update this thread. I'll post final agenda and the secure note with keys once Tom confirms. :thumbsup:
